title: Gene expression count matrix for T cell subtypes from ROSMAP participants
author: Elyaman, Wassim
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Isolate PBMCs by Ficoll gradient
steps.instruction: Isolate peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from ROSMAP participants using Ficoll gradient centrifugation.

steps.title: Sort T cell subtypes via flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Sort the isolated PBMCs on a high‑speed flow cytometer into four T‑cell subtypes: CD4+CD45RO‑, CD4+CD45RO+, CD8+CD45RO‑, and CD8+CD45RO+.

steps.title: Extract total RNA with buffer TCL
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from each sorted cell population using Qiagen buffer TCL.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑seq libraries (SC‑RNA‑Barcoding)
steps.instruction: Prepare RNA‑seq libraries from the extracted total RNA using the Single Cell RNA Barcoding and Sequencing method originally developed for single‑cell RNA‑seq, adapted for bulk total RNA.

steps.title: Collect libraries on 384‑well plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the prepared libraries into a single 384‑well plate, one well per sample.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on Illumina HiSeq (3’ DGE)
steps.instruction: Sequence the 384‑well plate on an Illumina HiSeq instrument using the High‑throughput 3’ Digital Gene Expression (DGE) library protocol.

steps.title: Generate RNA count matrix and plate map
steps.instruction: Produce the "RNA count matrix" file containing raw counts from the 384‑well plate and the "ROSMAP_Tcell_DGE_PlateMap" file containing well‑position metadata.
